subject: integration
name: Data gathering standard (DATA_GATHERING_0_1)
summary: Defines how a record's content is loaded one file at a time and checked against its content id (IPFS, Swarm, Arweave, torrent): a gather group only the browser calls, and a fetch group the browser answers itself through the sources the person ordered. The row names no source and makes no request. The definition lets the browser lower what a source claims about its own checks, never raise it, and says the serving source sees which content is fetched. The browser's answering code is separate from this row. Level 4 with privacy: a pure definition. Judged here by its publisher.
